The on-body injector is the IBD-only presentation of risankizumab (UC and Crohn's maintenance), so this per-beneficiary figure is pure IBD use at IBD dosing. It is self-injected in Part D, the setting duvakitug's all-subcutaneous Phase 3 regimen targets. It is the largest IBD-only series in the CMS file, 4.49 claims a beneficiary (69% of an eight-weekly year), and IL-23 is the class that sets the Crohn's anchor. Earlier years: $69,499 (2023), $79,759 (2024). Alternatives: Omvoh 2025 both presentations $61,181.65 over 262 (EUR 53,616.38); Entyvio Pen $49,396.23 over 2,282 (EUR 43,288.26). Tulisokibart, the other TL1A in these pools, carries Humira 2024 at $53,401 (EUR 46,797.83 at this rate). The two TL1As would therefore sit 1.83x apart. The book should put both on one IBD basis, and a reader must decide which one moves.

column11: Measured anchor: upadacitinib held 12.1% of US UC patients on advanced therapy in its fourth calendar year (Singh S et al., J Crohn's Colitis 2025, as mrk_tulisokibart.csv carries it). Reproduced on the pool (170,408 = 1,253,000 x 0.136; incidence 2,840), the curve (k 1.005, midpoint 2.15) and 27.5% discontinuation, the anchor peak is 0.1009. Identity on that path: year 0 stock 1,806 = 1,806 starts over 173,248 (1.04%). Year 1: 5,520 less 1,310 carried = 4,211 over 174,281 (2.42%). Year 2: 12,070 less 4,002 = 8,067 over 172,910 (4.67%). Year 3: 20,619 less 8,751 = 11,869 over 167,683 (7.08%), and the stock is 12.1% of the pool. Multiple 0.25, a judgement, half of the 0.5 tulisokibart takes. For: the highest Phase 2b UC effect reported for a TL1A (placebo-adjusted remission 27.4% at the high dose) and subcutaneous induction where tulisokibart and afimkibart load intravenously. Against: it is the third TL1A to market, behind tulisokibart (2028) and afimkibart (UC Phase 3 completes 2027-01-30), launching in 2030 into a UC market with the IL-23s, JAKs, S1Ps and vedolizumab, and Sanofi has no IBD franchise. Crowding: pool_crowding.solve with tulisokibart gives no rationed year. Duvakitug keeps 0.862 of its uncrowded peak, and tulisokibart falls from 1.0 to 0.931. Afimkibart will ration all three once it is modelled.
